summary: On paper Kansas City has the edge (Kansas City's defense ranks 26th in EPA per dropback with motion, +0.14 allowed), while Las Vegas's best counter is to move people pre-snap (Las Vegas ranks 1st in EPA per dropback with motion, +0.18). x-factor: Kenneth Walker III gains +2.1 rushing yards over expected per carry, 1st of 12. The model favors Kansas City at 57%, mostly on rushing matchup (2.4 pts) and offensive injuries (0.7 pts).
